title: Today we’ll share what we know of Isaac Bolton Shoemaker - Sept. 24, 1832 – Apr. 1
excerpt: Today we’ll share what we know of Isaac Bolton Shoemaker - Sept. 24, 1832 – Apr. 16, 1891. Wynona Lamborn told us about his sudden death in her diary last week. Isaac’s father, Thomas Shoemaker was born in Drumore. He was the 2nd child of 5
